compilation: Selected generated original uniformly resized from 1254x1254 to 768x768 with ImageMagick and losslessly encoded to WebP. No manual painting, anatomy reshaping, clipping, tinting or per-part transforms. Alpha is preserved through the standard resize; no threshold cleanup was applied.

sprite.measurement_note: Knee bottom y and contact runs are measured at alpha>128. Neck, hip and shoe landmarks are visual estimates for rigging. Coordinates are in full 768x768 canvas. Neck attach should be hidden under the existing head lower-neck edge; no extra visible neck needs drawing.

visual_validation: Inspected both generated originals and final WebP on a light-gray composite.
Selected final has exactly two arms, two hands, two knees and two shoes. Both hands balance above ground.
No head and no long neck; a short clean collar opening is available for existing head attachment.
Both legs remain folded across the front. Both shoes are raised off ground against the opposite folded leg; no extended shins or feet trail backward.
Two compact knee bottoms form the lowest main silhouette; their y positions match. The center notch between knees is transparent.
Lower-body width is contained within the upper torso/shoulder span rather than the first version wide frog-like spread.
Blue-teal suit, white shirt, dark tie, black shoes and crosshatched ink style match established character references.
No visible background, cast shadow, text, watermark, props, loose parts or photographic pixels.
limitations: Original video playback could not be observed by the researcher. Shape and raised-knee support are based on three verified stills. Alternating knee gait timing, roll and travel are animation interpretations, not verified frame-by-frame reconstruction.
Balancing arm poses and suit clothing deliberately differ from the original stage photo; the game uses its established character identity and clothes.
Shoe on screen left shows its sole strongly; shoe on screen right is more of an upper/side view. Both remain visibly folded in front.
Generated alpha includes tiny low-opacity pixels outside the visible figure. Use alpha>16 visible bounds for visual sizing, not nonzero-alpha bounds.
This is a single stable body pose; entry/exit transitions and dynamic knee-ground locking remain the renderer responsibility.
suggested_runtime_usage: Render one invariant folded-leg body with existing head or shout head attached at neck_attach_xy. To walk, rock the whole body mildly and translate to lock the chosen knee contact to the floor, alternating screen-left/right support. Do not swap in ordinary kneeling anatomy or distort/unfold the leg assembly. Ground anchor at neutral is [371,703].
